title: Warm lentil and feta salad
summary: Warm lentil and feta salad is a mediterranean dinner built around canned green lentils and feta, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook canned green lentils for Warm lentil and feta salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss feta with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Warm lentil and feta salad straight away. Taste Warm lentil and feta salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
